# Microsoft Clarity
> Free behavior analytics tool that helps teams understand website usage with session recordings, heatmaps, and insights.

Microsoft Clarity provides privacy-conscious analytics for websites, with documentation for setup, integrations, filtering, consent, and product features across web platforms and tag managers.

## Product
- [Microsoft Clarity](https://clarity.microsoft.com/): Main product application for creating projects, viewing recordings, heatmaps, and analytics dashboards.
- [Features](https://clarity.microsoft.com/features): Overview of Clarity capabilities including recordings, heatmaps, insights, and integrations.
- [Pricing](https://clarity.microsoft.com/pricing): Pricing information for Clarity plans and feature availability.
- [Sign in](https://clarity.microsoft.com/auth/login): Login page for accessing Clarity projects and dashboards.
- [Sign up](https://clarity.microsoft.com/auth/signup): Account registration flow for creating a new Clarity workspace.

## Documentation
- [Documentation home](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/): Central documentation hub for Microsoft Clarity setup, features, and administration.
- [Get started](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/get-started): Introductory guide for creating a project and installing Clarity on a site.
- [Install Clarity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-installation): Instructions for adding the Clarity tracking code to a website.
- [Clarity API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-api): Reference for the JavaScript API used to customize Clarity behavior.
- [Settings and management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/project-settings): Project configuration options and administrative controls.

## Setup and Installation
- [Setup and installation overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/): Entry point for installation, verification, and project configuration guidance.
- [Install with tracking code](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-installation): Add Clarity directly to site pages using the provided script snippet.
- [Install with Google Tag Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/google-tag-manager): Configure Clarity deployment through Google Tag Manager.
- [Install on single-page applications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/single-page-application): Guidance for enabling Clarity correctly on SPA frameworks and routed apps.
- [Verify installation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/verify-installation): Steps to confirm data collection is working after deployment.
- [Project settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/project-settings): Manage project metadata, domains, team access, and related settings.

## Filters and Data Controls
- [Filters overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/): Overview of filtering options for narrowing recordings, heatmaps, and dashboard data.
- [Custom tags](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/custom-tags): Use custom tags to segment sessions and analyze specific user cohorts.
- [Custom identifiers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/custom-identifiers): Associate sessions with your own user or account identifiers.
- [Masking content](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/masking): Control which page content is masked or excluded from capture.
- [IP blocking](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/ip-blocking): Exclude internal or unwanted traffic by blocking IP addresses.
- [URL filters](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/url-filters): Refine analysis by including or excluding specific page URLs.

## Consent and Privacy
- [Consent mode overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/consent-mode): Configure Clarity to respect user consent and privacy requirements.
- [Cookie consent integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/cookie-consent): Guidance for integrating Clarity with consent management workflows.
- [Masking](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/masking): Protect sensitive content by masking text, inputs, and selected elements.
- [Privacy FAQ](https://clarity.microsoft.com/privacy): Product privacy information and data handling details for Clarity users.
- [Microsoft Privacy Statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement): Microsoft-wide privacy statement covering data processing and user rights.

## Integrations
- [Integrations overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/): Documentation hub for connecting Clarity with advertising, analytics, and CMS platforms.
- [Google Analytics integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/google-analytics): Connect Clarity with Google Analytics for combined behavioral analysis.
- [Google Ads integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/google-ads): Use Clarity insights alongside Google Ads campaign performance.
- [Microsoft Advertising integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/microsoft-advertising): Link Clarity with Microsoft Advertising for campaign and landing-page analysis.
- [Shopify integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/shopify): Install and use Clarity on Shopify storefronts.
- [WordPress integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/integrations/wordpress): Add Clarity to WordPress sites using supported installation methods.

## Features and Analysis
- [Session recordings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/recordings): Review anonymized user sessions to understand navigation and friction.
- [Heatmaps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/heatmaps): Analyze click and scroll behavior across pages with visual heatmaps.
- [Dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/dashboard): Understand key metrics, trends, and behavioral insights from the main dashboard.
- [Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/insights): Explore automated signals such as rage clicks, dead clicks, and quick backs.
- [Segments](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/segments): Create reusable audience segments for focused analysis and reporting.
- [Funnels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/features/funnels): Track user progression through important conversion paths.

## Developers
- [JavaScript API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-api): Methods for setting consent, custom tags, and custom identifiers programmatically.
- [Single-page application support](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/single-page-application): Developer guidance for route changes and client-side rendered applications.
- [Custom tags](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/custom-tags): Implement custom tagging to enrich captured session data.
- [Custom identifiers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/filters/custom-identifiers): Pass application-specific identifiers into Clarity for analysis.
- [Google Tag Manager setup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/google-tag-manager): Deploy and manage Clarity through GTM in production environments.

## Support and Resources
- [Help center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/): Official support and product documentation for Microsoft Clarity.
- [Blog](https://clarity.microsoft.com/blog): Product updates, feature announcements, and usage guidance from the Clarity team.
- [FAQ](https://clarity.microsoft.com/faq): Answers to common questions about setup, usage, privacy, and billing.
- [Contact support](https://clarity.microsoft.com/support): Support entry point for Clarity users needing assistance.
- [Status page](https://status.clarity.ms/): Service availability and incident history for Microsoft Clarity.
